nodes.name: Legacy combat runtime capability
combat.json
weapons.json
Resolve one source-governed combat action
Complete source-reviewed combat family
Ordinary physical armor subtracts its rating from incoming damage
Automatic fire resolves declared ammunition in volleys with recoil penalties and per-volley hits
Combat rolls cannot be pushed
Combatants act from highest DEX to lowest with combat skill breaking ties
Melee dodge is opposed and ties favor the dodging defender
A combatant may flee close combat on their action if an escape route is open and they are unrestrained
Extreme attacks maximize damage and penetrating weapons add an impale damage roll
Melee fight back is opposed and ties favor the initiating attacker
Cover, diving, point blank, aiming, speed, size, reloading, and multiple shots modify firearm attacks
Base, long, and very-long range set Regular, Hard, and Extreme difficulty
Firearm attacks are normally unopposed and failure deals no damage
An attack roll at or above a weapon malfunction rating jams or misfires the weapon
Fighting maneuvers use Build penalties and become impossible at a three-point deficit
A successful fighting maneuver applies its declared non-damage goal
After a target defends in a round subsequent melee attackers gain a bonus die
Ranged and thrown attacks use firearm range difficulty and limited close defense
A readied firearm acts at DEX plus fifty
Combat proceeds in elastic rounds with one action opportunity per capable character
Weapon special effects include bounded Stun and escalating Burn
An unanticipated surprise attack may hit automatically or gain a bonus die
Successful attacks apply weapon damage and unarmed attacks use 1D3
Weapon profiles define skill, damage, range, uses, capacity, malfunction, and era
Canonical combat subsystem
